name: Python
description: Installs uv, Python, and Astral's native-binary Python tools (ruff, ty).

version.description: Python version to install via uv. 'latest' installs the newest stable, 'none' skips (uv still installed).

ruffVersion.description: ruff version tag (e.g., 0.15.10, no v prefix). Use 'none' to skip.

tyVersion.description: ty version tag (e.g., 0.0.30, no v prefix). Use 'none' to skip.
